last_session.text: The party reached Brandonsford at sunset, following a treasure map to places they did not recognize.
Reginald, a talking frog, warned Dr. Uriah to avoid a trickster Clurichen that comes into town nightly.
Dunk drank with Farmer Gill, who told him how Sir Brandon killed the town's first dragon.
Eric the Reeve offered a bounty for the dragon. Sir Phidipaldi then slapped him and challenged him to a duel.
Drop Dead Ned, a thief with a killer wasp, offered to work for Dr. Uriah, who said he would think about it.
Sir Phidipaldi agreed to help Quinn of the Golden Egg catch whoever takes his ale each night.

open.text: Find the treasure shown on the party's map.
Kill the black dragon and drag its body into town for Eric the Reeve's 1000 gold.
Catch whoever empties Quinn's good ale each night and collect his 100 gold.
If the party pays Lady Hilda, a seasoned fighter, she will join them to hunt the dragon. She won't go alone.
If Dr. Uriah hires Drop Dead Ned for 100 gold a week, Ned and his killer wasp will do anything, as long as Ned gets to kill people.
If Sir Phidipaldi and Quinn stage their fake ale delivery, they can see who comes for the ale.
Where are the map's marked places, and which one holds the treasure?
Who or what empties Quinn's good ale each night?
Where does the black dragon lurk outside Brandonsford?
What happened to Bentley's overdue shipment, and why has nothing arrived in months?
Where did the new dragon come from?
The black dragon tore off George the woodsman's arm and may harm others, including Gill's three sons, who are hunting it.
